data_instability.impact: same config produced different missing-data sets and different primary verdicts

change_summary: Added an experiment-only backtester exit path for `breakout_no_confirm`, screened six `(days, min_profit_R)` pairs on the accepted A+B stack, then took the only non-null candidate (`2 days`, `0.5R`) into the standard primary / bull / weak 3-window validation. A first pass looked mildly positive, but an immediate rerun on the same configuration produced a materially different primary result after yfinance rate-limited different tickers across runs. The experiment code was rolled back immediately instead of being promoted.

delta_metrics.note: The mechanism is directionally plausible, but the measured effect is not credible enough to accept because the sign of the primary-window result flipped across immediate reruns under different yfinance rate-limit failures. That makes this experiment a measurement-instability rejection, not a clean alpha acceptance or clean alpha falsification.

hypothesis: The remaining unblocked `breakout_long` leak may live in early follow-through failure rather than another ranking or allocation tweak. If a breakout trade has been open for 2 trading days, has failed to achieve even `0.5R` best excursion, and is already back below entry on the close, then forcing an early close may improve north-star EV by cutting weak breakouts before they consume more downside.
next_retry_requires: Do not promote `breakout fast-confirm exit` from this evidence alone
If breakout follow-through exit is revisited, first run it against a stable cached OHLCV snapshot or another pinned local data source so reruns are deterministic
Treat small EV uplifts under vendor-rate-limited downloads as non-actionable even when the mechanism itself sounds plausible
notes: This experiment still added useful mechanism information: breakout early follow-through remains a plausible direction, but the current repository data path is too unstable to accept a small exit-alpha edge whose sign flips across immediate reruns.

trigger.rule: after N trading days, if best_excursion_R < min_profit_R and close < entry, exit at close

rejection_reason: Rejected because the alpha verdict is not reproducible on the current data path. Immediate reruns of the same `breakout_no_confirm` configuration produced contradictory primary-window outcomes once different tickers failed to download, so Gate 4 cannot be trusted here.
